_readme: Radio library for index.html. Albums play in this order in Normal mode. To add an album, copy one entry and change every field. 'duration' is m:ss or h:mm:ss. 'cover' is a path on this site (or a full URL). 'file' must be a direct link to an MP3 the licence lets you stream and redistribute. Optional: 'year', 'label', 'licenceNote'. A track can override the album's 'licence' or 'source' with its own.
